## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |

## ScienceAgentBench 图像题（`scienceagentbench-eval`）

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | 判官只比较两张图，看不到题目、代码和数据 | `gpt4_visual_judge.py` 只发提示、预测图和 gold 图，提示里还说按题意随机生成的数据也算对；校准里任务 38 拿一张样式相同、数据不同的热图得 67 分通过（S5） | 样式对、数据错的图可能通过，热图一类尤其如此 | 标注；S2 的检查挡住直接拿 gold 图 |
| S2 | 被测程序能读到、也能改 gold 结果和 eval 程序 | 官方 harness 以 root 运行程序，benchmark 副本可写挂载，副本里有所有题的 gold 结果；我们第二步原先直接复用第一步程序写过的副本 | 程序可以复制 gold 图拿满分，或改 eval 程序 | 已修：判官步骤用资产的新副本、只读挂载，官方克隆有本地改动时拒绝运行判官；`project_checks` 报告第一步后 eval 程序和 gold 结果是否被改、增、删，输出是否与别的题的 gold 结果逐字节相同、图是否与本题 gold 图逐字节相同，程序文本是否提到评测侧的名字（`suspicious`）。数据输出与本题 gold 答案相同是正确程序的结果，只列出（`outputs_equal_own_gold`），不算可疑：任务 16 的真实运行就是这样 |
| S3 | 程序没有有效输出时仍调用判官，结果变成“不能打分” | 原代码不论 VER 都调判官；没有图时判官步骤读文件失败，抛 `ScoreUnavailable` | 失败的运行不计入，SR 被抬高 | 已修：VER 为 0 时不调判官，SR 按 harness 记 0 |
| S4 | 只留通过与否，样本分数丢了 | eval 程序只返回 `int(score >= 60)` 和回答原文，原文只留末尾 4000 字符 | 看不出离阈值多近 | 已修：用官方正则解析每个样本的分数，记 `samples`、均值、与 60 的差和解析失败数 |
| S5 | 阈值 60 没有对替代判官校准 | 原先只有任务 6 的两个点（#8、#35） | 替代判官整体偏宽或偏严会移动通过率 | 新增 `review sab-judge calibrate`：64 道图像题（65 张图）各用三种固定预测打分。gold 图本身：64/64 通过，样本全是 100；他题 gold 图：63/64 不通过，平均 3.1 分，唯一通过的是任务 38（配体相似度热图，拿到同样样式、数据不同的蛋白相似度热图，3 个样本 72、62、68）；空白图：64/64 不通过，全部 0 分。记录 `review-sab-judge-{gold,other,blank}-20261028T*` |

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |

## ScienceAgentBench figure tasks (`scienceagentbench-eval`)

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | The judge compares two images and sees neither the task, nor the code, nor the data | `gpt4_visual_judge.py` sends the prompt, the predicted and the gold figure only, and its prompt says randomly generated data per the query counts as correct; in the calibration task 38 passed with a heatmap of the same style and different data (67 points, S5) | A figure with the right style and wrong data can pass, heatmaps above all | Labelled; S2's checks stop taking the gold figure directly |
| S2 | The program under test can read, and change, the gold results and eval programs | The official harness runs the program as root with the benchmark copy mounted writable, and the copy holds every task's gold results; our second step used to reuse the copy the program had written to | A program can copy the gold figure for full marks, or change the eval program | Fixed: the judge step uses a fresh copy from the asset, mounted read-only, and refuses to run the judge when the official clone has local changes; `project_checks` reports eval programs and gold results changed, added or removed after step 1, outputs byte-identical to another task's gold result, figures byte-identical to the task's own gold figure, and evaluation-side names in the program text (`suspicious`). A data output equal to the task's own gold answer is what a correct program writes: it is listed (`outputs_equal_own_gold`) but not suspicious, as in the real run of task 16 |
| S3 | A program with no valid output still went to the judge, and the run became "cannot score" | The code called the judge whatever VER was; with no figure the judge step failed to read the file and raised `ScoreUnavailable` | Failed runs drop out, and SR goes up | Fixed: no judge when VER is 0; SR stays 0 as the harness gave it |
| S4 | Only pass or fail was kept; the sample scores were lost | The eval program returns only `int(score >= 60)` and the answers, of which the last 4000 characters were kept | How close a figure was to the threshold cannot be seen | Fixed: every sample's score parsed with the official regex into `samples`, with mean, distance to 60 and unparsed count |
| S5 | The 60-point threshold was not calibrated for the substitute judge | Only two points on task 6 before (#8, #35) | A substitute judge that is more lenient or strict overall shifts the pass rate | New `review sab-judge calibrate`: all 64 figure tasks (65 figures) judged with three fixed predictions. The gold figure itself: 64/64 pass, every sample 100; another figure task's gold figure: 63/64 fail, mean 3.1, the one pass is task 38 (a ligand-similarity heatmap given the protein-similarity heatmap of the same style and different data, samples 72, 62, 68); a white image: 64/64 fail, all 0. Records `review-sab-judge-{gold,other,blank}-20261028T*` |

run:

  source: [SNAP scienceagentbench.README.md "Evaluating Code Files", "REPO docs/20250110_docker/README.md"]
  pipeline:
    1_generate: "python -u run_infer.py --llm_engine_name {MODEL} --log_fname {LOG}.jsonl [--use_knowledge] [--use_self_debug]（官方 Direct/Self-Debug 基线）；OpenHands CodeAct 在 OpenHands 仓库 evaluation/benchmarks/scienceagentbench"
    2_extract: "python -u recover_pred_from_log.py --log_fname {LOG}.jsonl [--is_opendevin]  -> pred_programs/"
    3_evaluate: "python -m evaluation.harness.run_evaluation --benchmark_path benchmark --pred_program_path pred_programs --log_fname {EVAL}.jsonl --run_id {ID} [--cache_level none|base|instance] [--max_workers N] [--instance_ids ...] [--timeout 1800]"
    4_metrics: "python calculate_metrics.py --run_logs {LOG}... --eval_logs {EVAL}...（3 次运行取最佳）"
    source: [SNAP README, "REPO evaluation/harness/run_evaluation.py L446 (--timeout default 1800s)"]
  input_format: >-
    每个任务给 agent：task_inst + 数据集目录（benchmark/datasets/<dataset_folder_tree 第一行的目录名>（Issue #42 更正：不是 src_file_or_path，见官方 run_infer.py））+ dataset_folder_tree/dataset_preview，

    source: HF README.md Benchmark Structure
  output_format: >-
    agent 提交一个自包含 Python 程序 pred_programs/<gold_program_name>（由程序在容器内运行并写出 output_fname，

    output_fname 扩展名分布（HF csv 统计）：png 64, csv 25, json 4, npy 4, txt 3, pkl 1, tif 1。
    source: [SNAP README, HF csv output_fname 列]

    metrics: [SR 成功率, VER 有效程序率, CBS CodeBERTScore（对 gold program）, Cost]
    scoring_detail: "SR 由 eval 脚本按任务特定准则判定（测试集性能阈值、预测匹配、图像质量）；图像任务调用 GPT-4o 评判（gpt4_visual_judge.py，model=gpt-4o-2024-05-13，每次 [FINAL SCORE] 0-100）"

    runtime: Docker；harness 创建容器时未配置 GPU device_requests（grep 无 gpu/device_requests），即官方评测为 CPU 容器
    disk: "cache_level=base 时需 5 + max_workers*25 GB 空闲盘（instance 级缓存可达 2600 GB，不建议）"

evaluator.text:
# ScienceAgentBench

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml). This page covers what a reader needs and points to where each fact lives in the manifest.

## What it is

ScienceAgentBench measures whether an agent can write runnable Python programs for data-driven scientific discovery. There are 102 tasks adapted from 44 papers: bioinformatics 27, computational chemistry 20, geographical information science 27, psychology and cognitive science 28 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.task_stats`).

- Paper: arXiv 2410.05080, ICLR 2025 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`).
- Code: `OSU-NLP-Group/ScienceAgentBench`, pinned commit `c26e151ed601ba109dc4d35e057ff8e73fec469d`, MIT, redistribution allowed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.repo.pinned_commit`, `license.code`).
- Annotation sheet: Hugging Face `osunlp/ScienceAgentBench`, pinned revision `9c6e96c9e74572e979b0930ee735041cef528cb7`; it holds task inputs only, no gold or eval (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.dataset`).
- Full package: the `gold_programs`, `eval_programs` and `datasets` needed for evaluation are in the authors' encrypted package `benchmark_verified.zip` (the verified version of 2026/04/30, which fixes false negatives in evaluation); the maintainer downloaded it and the sha256 was checked. Use the verified split plus this package; the paper and most public scores are based on the old version (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.full_benchmark_artifact`, `source.version_note`).
- Licence: the annotation sheet is CC-BY-4.0; most task data is CC-BY-4.0, while task 3 (matminer) and tasks 32, 46, 53, 54, 84 (rasterio) keep their original licences. The authors explicitly forbid public redistribution of the unzipped data, so it stays out of Git (source: MANIFEST.yaml `license.data`).
- Data entry in this repo: asset ids `scienceagentbench-benchmark-verified` (not rebuildable, kept on Ubuntu only, not synced to the MacBook) and `scienceagentbench-hf-annotation-sheet`, read through the `assets/<id>` links (source: `assets/MANIFEST.yaml`, those two ids).

## Subset

All 102 tasks (`instance_id` 1 to 102). Reasons: the official evaluation is a CPU container; the official self-test of 102 tasks takes about 90 minutes with one worker and about 22 minutes with 8 workers; no task was excluded for GPU, and the 14 deep-learning tasks are also evaluated on CPU (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.decision`). Batch file: [`src/tasks/batches/scienceagentbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/scienceagentbench-subset.yaml).

The batch leaves out task 11 (`BBBC002_cell-count`) and has 101 tasks (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-28). The gold of task 11 trains a CNN without a fixed random seed, so its MAE varies around the threshold of 30; with the 1800 s deviation the maintainer approved, the Issue #64 acceptance still gave MAE 31.6 and SR 0. A score on this task means nothing for any system.

The 64 tasks whose output is a `.png` need the GPT-4o image judge; the other 38 are pure computation (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.needs_gpt4_judge`). Per-task time and data size were not measured, only global estimates exist (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.per_task_resource_estimate.caveat`).

## How it runs and is scored

- Official entry point: `python -m evaluation.harness.run_evaluation` (Docker-based, adapted from SWE-bench). The agent submits a self-contained Python program `pred_programs/<gold_program_name>`, which is run in a container and writes its result file (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.official_harness`, `run.pipeline`, `run.output_format`).
- Scoring: each task has its own `eval_programs/` script; the metrics are SR (success rate), VER (valid program rate), CBS (CodeBERTScore) and Cost. Image tasks are scored 0 to 100 by the GPT-4o judge (`gpt-4o-2024-05-13`, n=3, temperature 0.2), and a mean of at least 60 passes (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.verifier`, `subset.needs_gpt4_judge.rule`).

This project replaces the judge: calls go through codex-api, and the model that actually answers is `gpt-5.6-sol`; formal scoring uses effort medium (#8's check used low through the old Codex gateway; the maintainer decided on 2026-10-28 to keep medium for formal scoring, matching #48's judge calibration, Issue #64); sampling parameters such as `temperature` and `top_p` are ignored. Scores are therefore not directly comparable with the `gpt-4o` scores in the paper or on public leaderboards (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` ("GPT-4o 视觉判官路径"); PR #9).

GPT judges now go through codex-api (the Codex gateway was retired in #35); how to run them is in [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), "GPT judges through codex-api". The #8 evidence below was obtained through the old gateway.

Credential variable names (values never enter the repo): `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or the Azure set `AZURE_OPENAI_KEY`, `AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT`, `AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION`, `AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME`. `run_evaluation` raises an error without them even if no image task is run; through the gateway a placeholder value is used and `OPENAI_BASE_URL` points to the local gateway (source: MANIFEST.yaml `credentials`, `run.external_services`). For starting the gateway see [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), section "Official benchmark judges"; it is not repeated here.

## One item: what the system gets, how it is scored (Issue #42)

Written `scienceagentbench/<instance_id>` (1 to 102); any container system under test can run it:

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent scienceagentbench/16 --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort high \
  --credential anthropic=<variable> --config <settings file>
uv run researchworld_eval score scienceagentbench-eval <run-id>
```

- **Given to the system (the candidate side, rendered by `researchworld_eval.benchmarks.scienceagentbench`)**: the prompt
  of the official agent setting (OpenHands CodeAct, which the paper evaluates) verbatim, with nothing of ours added: the
  instruction in OpenHands `evaluation/benchmarks/scienceagentbench/run_infer.py` (commit `4507a25`), filled with
  `task_inst`, `dataset_folder_tree` and `dataset_preview` from the verified split of the annotation sheet. The dataset
  folder is at `/benchmark/datasets/<folder>`, where the prompt names it, and also at
  `/workspace/benchmark/datasets/<folder>`, as in OpenHands (both read-only; the official prompt names the first and
  OpenHands puts it at the second; maintainer decision of 2026-10-28 that the prompt match the environment, Issue #42
  comment 6463493133); `/workspace` is the system's working directory (an alias of `/work`). ResearchWorld gets the data
  at `/benchmark/datasets/<folder>`. `domain_knowledge` is not given (the paper's main setting; maintainer
  decision of 2026-10-28).
- **Never given**: `gold_programs/`, `eval_programs/` (with the gold results) and `scoring_rubrics/` of the full bundle;
  the renderer copies only this item's dataset folder.
- **Deliverable**: `/workspace/pred_programs/pred_<gold_program_name>`, copied to `out/deliverables/workspace/pred_programs/`.
- **Time limit**: the official protocol has none; 2 hours per item (maintainer decision of 2026-10-28), which `--hours`
  on the command line or `[conditions]` in the settings file can override.
- **Scoring**: the evaluator [`scienceagentbench-eval`](../../../evaluators/scienceagentbench_eval/README.en.md) first
  applies OpenHands' post-processing (`recover_pred_from_log.py`: `/workspace` in the program becomes `.`; the prompt's `/benchmark/datasets` likewise
  becomes `./benchmark/datasets`), then runs the
  program again with the official `run_evaluation` (verified split, one instance) and records VER, CBS and SR; the GPT-4o
  judge of the 64 figure tasks goes through codex-api (`gpt-5.6-sol`).
- **Network shield**: it blocks the benchmark repository, the HF dataset and project pages, and the upstream file each
  gold program was adapted from (the sheet's `github_name` + `src_file_or_path`; only that file, the rest of the
  repository such as its documentation stays reachable); the date bound of literature search is the benchmark's first
  public date, 2024-10-07 (evaluator-side [`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)).

### Differences from the official protocol

After a review against "match the official setting as closely as possible" (maintainer, 2026-10-28):

- Removed: the prompt is now the OpenHands text verbatim (the first round used a fragment of the self-debug agent's
  prompt plus Chinese framing and our delivery rules); paths, delivery location and the post-processing before scoring
  match OpenHands; no domain knowledge is given.
- Remaining differences and why:
  - A different agent framework: the official agentic setting is OpenHands CodeAct, here it is the system under test
    itself (for example Claude Code). That is exactly what is being compared.
  - Environment: the OpenHands sandbox image is `xingyaoww/openhands-eval-scienceagentbench`; here it is the system's own
    image, and the system installs software as needed. At scoring time every program is rerun in the official evaluation
    image, so the score depends only on the delivered program.
  - Network: the official protocol has no network limit; here the network-layer shield blocks the reference program's
    source and the benchmark itself. The shield adds to the official protocol, so the scores are not directly comparable
    with the official published ones.
  - Time limit: the official protocol gives the agent none; here it is 2 hours per item.
  - Data path: OpenHands' prompt names `/benchmark/datasets/<folder>`, while the data is at
    `/workspace/benchmark/datasets/<folder>`; here it is at both, and the post-processing before scoring maps both
    spellings onto the official evaluation's `./benchmark/datasets` (the official post-processing maps only `/workspace`).
  - Dataset split: OpenHands `run_infer.py` (commit `4507a25`) uses
    `load_dataset('osunlp/ScienceAgentBench', split='validation')`; here the prompt is filled from the authors' verified
    version of 2026/04/30, which goes with the full bundle `benchmark_verified.zip`. The two splits differ in the
    instructions of 13 tasks (MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.new_gap_candidates` SAB-N2); other per-task
    differences were not checked (`source.version_note`).
  - Automatic replies: when the agent stops for input, OpenHands answers with `codeact_user_response` ("please continue,
    use the finish tool when done, never ask for human help"; `fake_user_response_fn` in `run_infer.py`,
    `evaluation/utils/shared.py`); here the system under test gets no such message, and the run ends when the system stops.
  - The figure-task judge is substituted (see the evaluator README); the two oracle deviations the maintainer approved
    (saliva, BBBC002) have no hook in the official `run_evaluation`; the evaluator applies them in a re-run after
    the official step (Issue #64, see the evaluator README).

### Real run (2026-10-28)

Round 2 shows: the verbatim OpenHands prompt, the `/workspace` alias and the read-only data mount work in a real run, and the post-processing before scoring lets the program run in the official evaluation.

Not-verified items closed this time: a system's output scored through this project's commands; `run_evaluation` working
inside them. Still not verified: the figure-task judge step on a real run; the other 101 items; the variance of repeated runs.

### Scale and budget

The batch is all 102 items except task 11, 101 items (see Subset). One sample: item 16 took 64 s and 0.07 USD (first round) and is of the easiest kind; at
5-30 minutes and 0.1-1 USD per item, 102 items take about 10-50 agent hours and 10-100 USD; scoring takes about 8 minutes
per item (mostly the instance image build; about 3.5 hours for 102 items with 4 workers). The time limit is 2 hours per
item, and the cost cap stays the project default of 1000 USD per run (PR #40; maintainer decision of 2026-10-28); the
15 and 18 USD of the two calibration runs above were the caps in their settings files (`systems.coding-agent.max_budget_usd`
in the run directory's `settings.json`).

## Integrity check

#1 (PR #7) obtained the full package, built the base image and sampled 9 oracle tasks; #8 (PR #9) found the cause of the two failures, verified the old builder path and ran the judge path. Where the two differ, #8 wins: #1 recorded the saliva mismatch as "suspected unpinned dependency", and #8 confirmed the cause (source: PR #7; PR #9; MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`, `status_summary`).

| Check | Source | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Download and parse the annotation sheet | #1, 2026-10-26 | Pass: 102 rows |
| Repo HEAD equals the pinned commit | #1 | Pass |
| Full package `benchmark_verified.zip`: verify sha256 and unpack | #1 (re-check) | Pass: 1769478786 bytes, sha256 matches; 102 `gold_programs`, 110 `eval_programs` `.py` files |
| Base image `sab.base.x86_64:latest` (BuildKit) | #1 (retry) | Pass: about 3.5 minutes, 15.8 GB; the first build exceeded the 1500 s timeout |
| Oracle sample of 9 tasks (gold program plus official eval program, fallback path) | #1 | 7 pass; saliva mismatch; `BBBC002_cell-count` timeout |
| Cause of saliva and pinned rerun | #8 | Confirmed: `biopsykit` switched skew to a biased estimate from 0.12.2; with `biopsykit==0.12.0` the gold passes |
| Gold of `BBBC002_cell-count` | #8 | Passes, but takes about 1026 s, over the harness's hard-coded 900 s |
| Harness old builder path (`docker_build`) | #8 | Pass: saliva instance image 345.7 s, BBBC002 372.1 s |
| GPT-4o visual judge path (task 6, Codex gateway) | #8 | Pass: gold as prediction scored 100 in all 3 samples, negative control 0 in all |
| Official `run_evaluation` end to end (gold as prediction, tasks 16, 6, 7) | #8 | Partial: task 16 passes; the judge for tasks 6 and 7 got 401 inside the container |

Notes:

- saliva: the official flow does not pin versions and installs the latest `biopsykit` 0.14.0, so even the gold gets SR=0 (returns `(1, 0.9146, 0, 'N/A')`); pinned to 0.12.0 it returns `(1, 1.0, 1, 'N/A')` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (oracle item); PR #9).
- `eval_programs` in the package has 8 more scripts than the 102 tasks; they are leftover scripts in the release and do not take part in scoring the 102 tasks. 69 of the 110 scripts depend on the GPT judge (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` ("获取完整 benchmark")).
- The judge failed for tasks 6 and 7 because the container uses the default bridge network and cannot reach the gateway, which listens only locally; the judge call went to the real `api.openai.com` and was rejected with 401 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (`run_evaluation` item), `judge_not_served_by_gateway`).
- Deviations approved by the maintainer (2026-10-26): our runner runs `pip install biopsykit==0.12.0` for saliva first; raises the 900 s timeout of `BBBC002_cell-count` to 1800 s; judge tasks in `run_evaluation` do not go through a gateway inside the container, and the judge path is evidenced only by a real run at the eval-program level (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.maintainer_decisions`; PR #9). Since Issue #64 the evaluator applies the first two: when the official step does not pass, it re-runs once in the same instance image with the deviation, and the score keeps the official step's metrics.
- Still not verified (as of #8; #42 ran `run_evaluation` on a system's item 16, see above): scores of judge tasks through `run_evaluation`; `run_evaluation` covered only 3 tasks; the oracle sampled only 9 tasks; intermediate scores and judge variance; per-task differences between the verified and old versions; CodeBERTScore appeared only in the 3 `run_evaluation` tasks (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`, `source.version_note`).

## Published reference scores

Paper Table 3 (old data, best of 3 runs per task, no time limit): Self-Debug + `o1-preview` has SR 42.2% (41.2% with domain knowledge); Self-Debug + Claude-3.5-Sonnet 32.4% (34.3%); OpenHands CodeAct + Claude-3.5-Sonnet 21.6% (24.5%) (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.entries`).

Where this differs from the project protocol: the paper uses the old data, and public baseline scores for the verified version were not checked; the paper's models are from 2024; it takes the best trajectory of 3 runs; image tasks are judged by `gpt-4o-2024-05-13` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`).

## Known issues and limits

- The LLM judges' problems and their handling are in S1–S5 of [`../JUDGES.en.md`](../JUDGES.en.md): the figure judge only compares two images; the program under test can read the gold results; the 60-point threshold had not been calibrated for the substitute judge. Official scores are recorded unchanged; the integrity problems fixed, the integrity checks and the calibration of the substitute judge are reported apart from them (Issue #48).
- The official `requirements.txt` has defects: `litellm==1.52.8` does not exist on PyPI (evaluation does not need it); `docker_py` and the same-named `docker` package that `swebench` depends on overwrite each other, so only `docker==7.2.0` should be installed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (`run_evaluation` item), `upstream_defects`).
- The harness writes the values of `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `AZURE_*` into the ENV layer of instance images, so an image built with a real key contains the key and must not be pushed or shared; the harness also mounts the benchmark writable (source: same).
- The gold of `BBBC002_cell-count` uses about 6.5 CPU hours and on average about 22 cores; the time includes contention on a shared host (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (oracle item)).
- The gold of `BBBC002_cell-count` (task 11) trains a CNN with deepchem without a fixed random seed, and its MAE varies around the threshold of 30: 28.9 in #8 (pass), 31.6 in Issue #64's acceptance (fail). With the raised timeout the task no longer fails for time, but its score is random (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.maintainer_decisions.acceptance_issue_64`; the evaluator README, "Calibration").
- Disk: `cache_level=base` needs 5 + `max_workers` x 25 GB of free disk (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.containers.disk`).
- The project does not call the official judge snapshot `gpt-4o-2024-05-13` (it has no OpenAI key); `gpt-5.6-sol` on codex-api replaces it, so scores are not comparable with published ones (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.ours_to_decide`).
- Evidence for a WP candidate subset is insufficient, so none is chosen yet (source: MANIFEST.yaml `wp_candidate_subset`).
- MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration` is the HuTian interface specification #1 wrote before any run, not updated since. Current state: ResearchWorld has real runs on this benchmark (see "Real run", MANIFEST.yaml `task_interface.real_runs`); benchmark items do not go through this project's shield proxy, so the blocklist can only become whole-host denials on HuTian's network, and URL rules on shared hosts and the date bound do not apply ([ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.en.md), "Benchmark items"). Candidate gaps are collected in `.agents/knowledge/project/hutian-gaps.md` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.current_status`).

# ScienceAgentBench

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文只说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出每条事实在 manifest 里的位置。

## 是什么

ScienceAgentBench 衡量 agent 能否为数据驱动的科学发现写出可运行的 Python 程序。共 102 个任务，改编自 44 篇论文，覆盖生物信息学 27、计算化学 20、地理信息科学 27、心理学与认知科学 28（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.task_stats`）。

- 论文：arXiv 2410.05080，ICLR 2025（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`）。
- 代码：`OSU-NLP-Group/ScienceAgentBench`，固定 commit `c26e151ed601ba109dc4d35e057ff8e73fec469d`，MIT，可再分发（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.repo.pinned_commit`、`license.code`）。
- 标注表：Hugging Face `osunlp/ScienceAgentBench`，固定 revision `9c6e96c9e74572e979b0930ee735041cef528cb7`，只含任务输入，不含 gold 和 eval（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.dataset`）。
- 完整包：评测必需的 `gold_programs`、`eval_programs`、`datasets` 在作者发布的加密包 `benchmark_verified.zip`（2026/04/30 的 verified 版，修复评测假阴性）里，由维护者下载并核对 sha256。应使用 verified split 加这个包；论文和多数公开分数基于旧版（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.full_benchmark_artifact`、`source.version_note`）。
- 许可：标注表 CC-BY-4.0；多数任务数据 CC-BY-4.0，任务 3（matminer）和 32、46、53、54、84（rasterio）保留原许可证。官方明确不得公开再分发解压后的数据，所以本项目不入 Git（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license.data`）。
- 本仓库的数据入口：资产 id `scienceagentbench-benchmark-verified`（不可重建，只留在 Ubuntu，不同步到 MacBook）和 `scienceagentbench-hf-annotation-sheet`，通过 `assets/<id>` 链接读取（来源：`assets/MANIFEST.yaml` 这两个 id）。

## 子集

取全部 102 个任务（`instance_id` 1 到 102）。依据：官方评测是 CPU 容器；官方自测 102 个任务单 worker 约 90 分钟、8 worker 约 22 分钟；没有任务因 GPU 被排除，14 个深度学习任务也在 CPU 上评测（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.decision`）。批次文件：[`src/tasks/batches/scienceagentbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/scienceagentbench-subset.yaml)。

批次去掉了任务 11（`BBBC002_cell-count`），共 101 个任务（维护者 2026-10-28 决定）。原因是任务 11 的 gold 训练 CNN 时没有固定随机种子，MAE 在阈值 30 附近波动；加上维护者批准的 1800 秒偏差后，Issue #64 的验收仍是 MAE 31.6、SR 0。这样任何系统在这题上得分都没有意义。

输出为 `.png` 的 64 个任务要用 GPT-4o 图像 judge，其余 38 个纯计算（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.needs_gpt4_judge`）。逐任务的耗时和数据量没有实测，只有全局估计（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.per_task_resource_estimate.caveat`）。

## 怎么运行和评分

- 官方入口：`python -m evaluation.harness.run_evaluation`（Docker 化，改自 SWE-bench）。agent 提交一个自包含的 Python 程序 `pred_programs/<gold_program_name>`，在容器里运行并写出结果文件（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.official_harness`、`run.pipeline`、`run.output_format`）。
- 评分：每个任务有专属的 `eval_programs/` 脚本，指标是 SR（成功率）、VER（有效程序率）、CBS（CodeBERTScore）和 Cost。图像任务由 GPT-4o judge（`gpt-4o-2024-05-13`，n=3，temperature 0.2）打 0 到 100，均分不低于 60 算通过（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.verifier`、`subset.needs_gpt4_judge.rule`）。

本项目替换了 judge：经 codex-api 调用，实际回答的模型是 `gpt-5.6-sol`，正式评分的 effort 是 medium（#8 的检查经旧 Codex 网关用 low；维护者 2026-10-28 决定正式评分保持 medium，与 #48 的判官校准一致，Issue #64），`temperature` 和 `top_p` 等采样参数被忽略。所以分数不能与论文或公开榜单中的 `gpt-4o` 分数直接比较（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`（「GPT-4o 视觉判官路径」）；PR #9）。

GPT 判官现在经 codex-api（Codex 网关已在 #35 退役），运行方式见 [`USER.md`](../../../../USER.md)“GPT 判官：经 codex-api”；下面 #8 的证据是经旧网关得到的。

凭据变量名（值不进仓库）：`OPENAI_API_KEY`，或 Azure 组合 `AZURE_OPENAI_KEY`、`AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT`、`AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION`、`AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME`。`run_evaluation` 没有这些变量会直接报错，即使不跑图像任务；经网关时填占位值，并设 `OPENAI_BASE_URL` 指向本机网关（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `credentials`、`run.external_services`）。网关的启动步骤见 [`USER.md`](../../../../USER.md)「benchmark 的官方 judge」一节，这里不重复。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分（Issue #42）

写作 `scienceagentbench/<instance_id>`（1 到 102），任何容器类被测系统都可以运行：

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent scienceagentbench/16 --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort high \
  --credential anthropic=<变量名> --config <设置文件>
uv run researchworld_eval score scienceagentbench-eval <run-id>
```

- **给系统的（候选侧，`researchworld_eval.benchmarks.scienceagentbench` 渲染）**：官方 agent 设置（论文评测的 OpenHands
  CodeAct）的提示原文，逐字、不加任何我们的说明：OpenHands `evaluation/benchmarks/scienceagentbench/run_infer.py`（commit
  `4507a25`）里的 instruction，填入标注表 verified split 的 `task_inst`、`dataset_folder_tree`、`dataset_preview`。数据目录
  放在提示写明的 `/benchmark/datasets/<目录>`，也和 OpenHands 一样放在 `/workspace/benchmark/datasets/<目录>`（都只读；官方提示
  写前者、OpenHands 实际放在后者，维护者 2026-10-28 决定让提示与环境一致，Issue #42 评论 6463493133）；`/workspace` 是系统的工作
  目录（`/work` 的别名）。ResearchWorld 在 `/benchmark/datasets/<目录>` 拿到数据。不给 `domain_knowledge`（论文主设置；维护者 2026-10-28 决定）。
- **不给的**：完整包里的 `gold_programs/`、`eval_programs/`（含 gold 结果）、`scoring_rubrics/`；渲染按白名单只复制本题的数据目录。
- **交付物**：`/workspace/pred_programs/pred_<gold_program_name>`，复制到 `out/deliverables/workspace/pred_programs/`。
- **时间上限**：官方没有；每题 2 小时（维护者 2026-10-28 决定），命令行 `--hours` 或设置文件 `[conditions]` 可另定。
- **评分**：评测系统 [`scienceagentbench-eval`](../../../evaluators/scienceagentbench_eval/README.md) 先做 OpenHands 的后处理
  （`recover_pred_from_log.py`：程序里的 `/workspace` 换成 `.`；提示的 `/benchmark/datasets` 同样换成 `./benchmark/datasets`），再用官方 `run_evaluation`（verified split，单题）重新运行程序，

### 与官方协议的差异

按“尽可能与官方设置一致”（维护者 2026-10-28）复查后：

- 已消除：提示改为 OpenHands 原文逐字（第一轮是自调试 agent 的提示片段加中文说明和交付约定）；路径、交付位置和评分前的后处理
  与 OpenHands 一致；不给 domain knowledge。
- 仍有的差异和原因：
  - agent 框架不同：官方 agentic 设置是 OpenHands CodeAct，这里是被测系统自己（例如 Claude Code）。这正是被比较的对象。
  - 运行环境：OpenHands 的沙箱镜像是 `xingyaoww/openhands-eval-scienceagentbench`；这里是被测系统自己的镜像，系统按需安装软件。
    评分时程序都在官方评测镜像里重跑，所以分数只取决于交付的程序。
  - 联网：官方没有联网限制；这里用网络层屏蔽挡参考程序的来源和 benchmark 自身。屏蔽补充了官方协议，分数因此不与官方公开分数
    直接可比。
  - 时间上限：官方没有给 agent 的上限，这里每题 2 小时。
  - 数据路径：OpenHands 的提示写 `/benchmark/datasets/<目录>`，数据却在 `/workspace/benchmark/datasets/<目录>`；这里两处都有，评分前
    的后处理把两种写法都换到官方评测的 `./benchmark/datasets`（官方后处理只换 `/workspace`）。
  - 数据集 split：OpenHands `run_infer.py`（commit `4507a25`）用 `load_dataset('osunlp/ScienceAgentBench', split='validation')`；
    这里按作者 2026/04/30 的 verified 版填提示，与完整包 `benchmark_verified.zip` 配套。两个 split 有 13 题的指令不同（MANIFEST.yaml
    `researchworld_integration.new_gap_candidates` SAB-N2），其余逐题差异未核实（`source.version_note`）。
  - 自动回复：OpenHands 在 agent 停下等待输入时，用 `codeact_user_response` 回一句“请继续，完成后用 finish 工具，不要求助人类”
    （`run_infer.py` 的 `fake_user_response_fn`，`evaluation/utils/shared.py`）；这里不给被测系统发这句话，系统自己结束即结束。
  - 图像题判官被替换（见评测系统 README）；维护者批准的两个 oracle 偏差（saliva、BBBC002）在官方 `run_evaluation` 里没有钩子，由评测系统在官方步骤之后复跑施加（Issue #64，见评测系统 README）。

## 完整性检查

#1（PR #7）取得完整包、构建基础镜像并抽样 9 题 oracle；#8（PR #9）查明两个失败、验证旧 builder 路径并跑通 judge 路径。两处不一致时以 #8 为准：#1 把 saliva 的不一致记为「疑为依赖未锁定」，#8 已确认原因（来源：PR #7；PR #9；MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check`、`status_summary`）。

## 公开对照分数

论文 Table 3（旧版数据，每任务 3 次运行取最佳，无时间上限）：Self-Debug + `o1-preview` 的 SR 为 42.2%（带领域知识 41.2%）；Self-Debug + Claude-3.5-Sonnet 为 32.4%（34.3%）；OpenHands CodeAct + Claude-3.5-Sonnet 为 21.6%（24.5%）（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.entries`）。

与本项目协议不一致之处：论文用旧版数据，verified 版的公开基线分数未核实；论文模型是 2024 年的；取 3 次运行的最佳轨迹；图像任务用 `gpt-4o-2024-05-13` 评判（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`）。

## 已知问题和限制

- LLM 判官的问题和处理见 [`../JUDGES.md`](../JUDGES.md) 的 S1–S5：图像题判官只比两张图；被测程序能读到 gold 结果；替代判官的 60 分阈值原先没有校准。官方分数照录，已修的完整性问题、完整性检查和替代判官的校准与官方分数分开报告（Issue #48）。
- 官方 `requirements.txt` 有缺陷：`litellm==1.52.8` 在 PyPI 上不存在（评测不需要）；`docker_py` 与 `swebench` 依赖的 `docker` 同名包互相覆盖，需只装 `docker==7.2.0`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`（`run_evaluation` 一项）`upstream_defects`）。
- harness 把 `OPENAI_API_KEY` 和 `AZURE_*` 的值写进实例镜像的 ENV 层，用真实 key 构建的镜像含密钥，不得推送或共享；harness 还以可写方式挂载 benchmark（来源：同上）。
- `BBBC002_cell-count` 的 gold 约用 6.5 个 CPU 小时、平均约 22 核；耗时包含共享主机的争用（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`（oracle 一项））。
- `BBBC002_cell-count`（任务 11）的 gold 用 deepchem 训练 CNN、没有固定随机种子，MAE 在阈值 30 附近波动：#8 为 28.9（通过），Issue #64 验收为 31.6（不通过）。放宽超时后这道题不再因超时失败，但分数带随机性（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.maintainer_decisions.acceptance_issue_64`；评测系统 README“校准结果”）。
- 磁盘：`cache_level=base` 需要 5 + `max_workers` × 25 GB 空闲盘（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.containers.disk`）。
- 官方 judge 快照 `gpt-4o-2024-05-13` 本项目不调用（没有 OpenAI key），由 codex-api 上的 `gpt-5.6-sol` 替代，分数不与公开分数可比（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.ours_to_decide`）。
- WP 候选子集证据不足，暂不选（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `wp_candidate_subset`）。
- MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration` 是 #1 在运行前写的 HuTian 接口规格，没有随实现更新。现状：ResearchWorld 已在本 benchmark 上真实运行（见“真实运行”、MANIFEST.yaml `task_interface.real_runs`）；benchmark 题目不经本项目的屏蔽代理，屏蔽表只能化成 HuTian 网络的整主机拒绝，共用主机上的 URL 规则和日期上限不生效（[ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.md)“benchmark 题目”）。缺口候选汇总在 `.agents/knowledge/project/hutian-gaps.md`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.current_status`）。

preinstalled.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator container has the host docker socket (root-equivalent on the host).

preinstalled.en: python:3.11 bookworm; upstream code via PYTHONPATH; pdflatex + bibtex; CPU PyTorch with numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas, matplotlib and more (pinned by constraints.txt)

notes.model: claude-opus-5-5 through the Anthropic Messages API (llm.provider=anthropic), no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. Requests carry model, messages and max_tokens only (no tools, no thinking parameter); ARC's per-stage temperature is not sent because the model rejects it, so the API default applies.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain chat completions. conditions.agent=claude means only that the provider is Anthropic; Claude Code is not involved. Generated experiments run as a plain subprocess in the container.
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5 thinks by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (for example 4096) is shared with the thinking tokens, so long outputs can still be cut short.
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE and RWE_EFFORT switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s, refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md verbatim with whitespace collapsed. Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.
notes.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: every request to api.anthropic.com is built in researchclaw/llm/anthropic_adapter.py:136-148 and carries only model, messages, max_tokens, optional temperature, output_config.effort and system, never a tools or web_search field; the OpenAI-compatible client (OpenRouter :online / plugins) is not used (llm.provider=anthropic), web_search.enabled=false, Gemini is only used by the disabled figure_agent.nano_banana. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so such a path would be invisible to the audit.
notes.secrets: Generated experiment code inherits the container environment, including the API keys (ARC offers no switch to scrub it).
notes.profile: project.profile=ml_generic is fixed for all tasks; research.domains is left empty because the literature screen rejects papers outside the stated domain (a theory task failed with domains=[machine-learning]).
